shortBulletSummary: US-Iran geopolitical tensions weigh on crypto markets, leading to market declines.
Bitcoin drops to $63K and major altcoins see corrections of up to 11%.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index is neutral at 53 as of July 18, 2026.
Positive impact of soft US inflation data on crypto is limited by geopolitical tensions.
Bitcoin ETFs see net inflows, but institutional caution remains after earlier outflows.
